title: 第三千三百六十八章 反话第三千三百六十七章 拉扯
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
第三千三百六十八章反话？
血甲大汉扭头看去，看到从天际落下的秦天和殷洛璃后，顿时笑了。
“没想到临走时，居然又来了两只猪仔。”
“猪仔？”秦天笑了，你们倒是真挺像猪仔的。
血甲大汉闻言，神色顿时冷了下来。
“男猪仔你去解决，这女猪仔嘛！”侏儒一脸不怀好意地搓了搓手，对着殷洛璃喉咙鼓动了一下。
秦天见侏儒一副猥琐样，顿时眉头一蹙。
下一刻他便消失在原地，当他再次出现时，已经来到了侏儒身边。
抬手一拳便砸在了侏儒的额头上，将其天灵盖打得凹了进去，整个人呈大字形倒在了地上，将地上砸出一个大坑，扬起灰尘。
突如其来的袭击让侏儒三人都没反应过来。
秦问天一脚踩在了侏儒的胸口上，俯视下去，脚微微用力往下碾：“敢惦记我的女人，我看你是找死！”
“啊！”侏儒发出凄厉的惨叫声，他的五脏碎了，鲜血不停地往外涌出。
他疯狂地反抗，发现自己无论如何也反抗不了。
只能用求救的眼神看向一旁的血甲大汉。
此刻血甲大汉和另外一位老者也是懵了。
他们知道侏儒的实力，和自己伯仲之间。
就算是他被偷袭，也不可能如此这般没有还手之力。
眼前这个景象只有一个解释，那就是眼前的少年比他们都强，而且还不止强一星半点。
“小子，你到底是谁？你想干什么？”
“我们是来行侠仗义的。”

“你们最近坑杀了不少人吧？现在也该付出代价了。”
血甲大汉脸色一沉，他知道对方是奔着他们手中的天门令而来的。
眼珠子转了转后，他看向侏儒：“兄，对不住了。”
话音落，他直接化为一道血光，朝着远处遁逃。
但刚飞去没多远，便被突然出现的殷洛璃挡住了去路。
老者感受到殷洛璃所散发出的气息，脸色变得更沉了。
因为殷洛璃让他有一种很危险的感觉。
难不成今天要栽在这里了？
血甲大汉当即做出决定：“二位大人，我看你们应该也是求财的，不如这样，我将手中的天门令全部给你们，你们放我一马如何？”
殷洛璃闻言，看向了秦天。
“不行。”秦天一口拒绝，他看向血甲大汉：“都说了，我们是来替天行道的，坑杀了那么多人，我们杀了你，也算是大功德一件。”
“多行善事总归是有好处的。”秦天笑着一发力，直接将脚下的侏儒踩成了一片血雾，就像踩死一只蚂蚁一样。
随即，他转身，大步走向了血甲大汉。
血甲大汉顿时被吓得冷汗直冒，他直接跪了下来，颤抖着说道：“饶我一命吧，我不想死，只要你肯饶了我，我愿意付出我的忠诚。”
秦天来到血甲大汉的身前，停住了脚步，他微微摇头：“你不过是随手可以秒杀的垃圾，有何资格当我的小弟？”
说完，他屈指对着血甲大汉的眉心一点。
血甲大汉顿时身体一僵，在恐惧中化为了血雾。
随后他看向了正在逃跑的老者，一个剑指点了过去。
第三千三百六十八章反话？
一道剑气瞬间从老者的背后穿过，老者僵直在空中，随后跌落在地，死的不能再死了。
content_en:
Chapter 3368 Irony?
The big man in blood armor turned around and smiled immediately after seeing Qin Tian and Yin Luoli falling from the sky.
"I didn't expect that before I left, two more piglets came."
"Piggy?" Qin Tian smiled, you really look like piggy.
When the big man in blood armor heard this, his expression suddenly turned cold.
"You go and deal with the male piggy, this female piggy!" The dwarf rubbed his hands with a malicious look on his face, and made a move on Yin Luoli's throat.
Qin Tian frowned when he saw the dwarf looking wretched.
The next moment he disappeared, and when he reappeared, he had already arrived at the dwarf's side.
He raised his hand and punched the dwarf on the forehead, denting his Tianling Cap. He fell to the ground in a large shape, making a big hole in the ground and raising dust.
The sudden attack prevented the three dwarfs from reacting.
Qin Wentian stepped on the dwarf's chest, looked down, and pressed his foot down slightly: "Any woman who dares to miss me, I think you are seeking death!"
"Ah!" The dwarf let out a shrill scream. His internal organs were shattered and blood kept pouring out.
He resisted crazily and found that he couldn't resist anyway.
He could only look at the big man in blood armor beside him with eyes asking for help.
At this moment, the big man in blood armor and another old man were also confused.
They knew that the dwarf was as strong as themselves.
Even if he was attacked by surprise, it would be impossible for him to be so helpless to fight back.
There is only one explanation for the scene in front of them, and that is that the young man in front of them is stronger than them all, and he is more than a little stronger.
"Boy, who are you? What do you want to do?"
"We are here to do justice."
"You have tricked and killed many people recently, right? Now it's time to pay the price."
The blood-armored man's face darkened. He knew that the other party was coming for the Tianmen Token in their hands.
After rolling his eyes, he looked at the dwarf: "Brother, I'm sorry."
As soon as he finished speaking, he turned into a streak of blood and fled into the distance.
But not far after flying, the way was blocked by Yin Luoli who suddenly appeared.
The old man's face became darker when he felt the aura exuded by Yin Luoli.
Because Yin Luoli made him feel very dangerous.
Is it possible that I am going to end up here today?
The big man in blood armor immediately made a decision: "Two adults, I think you are also looking for money. How about this? I will give you all the Tianmen Order in my hand. How about you let me go?"
Upon hearing this, Yin Luoli looked at Qin Tian.
"No." Qin Tian refused. He looked at the big man in blood armor and said, "As I said, we are here to do justice for heaven. We have tricked and killed so many people. If we kill you, it will be considered a great merit."
"Doing more good deeds always pays off." Qin Tian smiled and used his strength to trample the dwarf under his feet into a bloody mist, just like crushing an ant to death.
Immediately, he turned around and strode towards the big man in blood armor.
The big man in blood armor was so frightened that he broke into a cold sweat. He knelt down and said tremblingly: "Spare my life. I don't want to die. As long as you are willing to spare me, I am willing to pay my loyalty."
Qin Tian came to the big man in blood armor and stopped. He shook his head slightly: "You are just trash that can be killed instantly. How can you be my little brother?"
After saying that, he pointed his finger at the forehead of the big man in blood armor.
The big man in blood armor suddenly stiffened and turned into blood mist in fear.
Then he looked at the running old man and pointed with his sword.
Chapter 3368 Irony?
A ray of sword energy passed through the old man's back in an instant. The old man froze in the air, and then fell to the ground. He could no longer die.
